description: Ministry of Sports - Substitution for the Service Minute of the Combined Service Officers in the Field of Sports of the Department of Sports Development published in Gaz. No. 1009 of 02.01.1998
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns public service administration, specifically the Service Minutes for officers in the Sports Development Department. It details service categories, grades, salary scales, and cadre approvals for sports officers, which falls under public sector service conditions and administration. While it mentions the Public Service Commission and its Secretary, it does not focus on government structural changes or individual personnel appointments with detailed portfolios, placing it clearly in the Public Service category.
